messages:
maria: Quick check — telemetry cutover is scheduled for next Thu 09:00 PT. Need a consolidated status for dashboards, trace hooks, error-analysis views, and retention migration. Who's the final owner for the cutover and the post-cutover smoke tests? Also list any blockers (eng-sre sampling, perms, rollback plan).

chris: Dashboards — PR #482 merged to prod-alpha, staging dashboards look good. Still need a final runbook for the post-cutover smoke checklist (queries + breakpoint thresholds). I can take runbook but need write perms on the prod dashboard folder. :thumbsup:

leo: Trace hooks — most services have the new trace_hook middleware; I have an open PR for the client libs (WIP). Waiting on a couple of reviews (esp. from @anya for rollout policy). One note: current trace payload size spikes in perf tests when sampling=100%. We should default to 5% in prod during cutover. :eyes:

anya: I can own rollout policy and routing for the rollout. Plan: canary 10% for 1 hour, ramp 50% for 2 hours, then full. I need eng-sre to set sampling to 5% for the canary window and a quick rollback toggle. Also confirm retention change: are we moving to 90d from 30d? That affects storage cost. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: I can own the retention migration script and the data-kickoff. Here's the draft migration command I'll run in the migration job: 

```bash
# remove old short-lived traces, consolidate index
python tools/trace_migrate.py --src=prod_traces --dst=prod_traces_90d --cutoff-days=90 --dry-run
```

I'll run dry-run in staging tomorrow and post results. Need DB write window from infra (ETA during cutover).

chris: For error-analysis views — I've added the new 'regression' panel to the dashboard but need a couple of sample queries for false-positive filtering. @maria can you share the eval prompt set we used for the last quality run?

maria: Pushed the eval set to the docs repo: https://git.internal/redwood/telemetry/evals/obs-cutover.md — includes the top 50 signal prompts. Also adding the acceptance criteria to the runbook now.

leo: Small config snippet for the trace hook that reviewers asked about: 

```python
# enable minimal metadata to keep payloads small
TRACE_HOOK_CONFIG = {
  'sample_rate': 0.05,
  'include_headers': ['x-request-id'],
  'max_span_bytes': 1024,
}
```

anya: For SLOs, we should measure: trace ingest latency, dashboard query 95th, and error-analysis false positive rate. I'll draft SLO targets and share by EOD.

devops-bot: Canary job scheduled: obs-cutover-canary on 2026-03-19T16:00:00Z. Notifying eng-sre. :robot_face:

sam: Blocker: eng-sre needs to expose the dynamic sampling toggle in prod. Who's the eng-sre contact? I can reach out, but want to tag here.

maria: Pinging @eng-sre on the interlock channel now. Also tagging @ops-team in the runbook for the write window.

chris: Action items summary:
- maria: finalize runbook + acceptance criteria (owns)
- sam: run migration dry-run + migration job (owns)
- anya: rollout policy + SLOs (owns)
- leo: finish trace lib PR and reduce default sampling in prod canary (owns)
- chris: finish error-analysis queries + get write perms for prod dashboards (owns request)

maria: OK, I'll put these into the roadmap ticket and assign owners. If nobody objects, I'll lock the cutover timeline by EOD. :zap:

leo: One more note — if rollback is triggered we'll switch routing back and replay a trimmed trace subset for debugging. Need a small replay harness; I can add a basic one tomorrow.

anya: Sounds good. If eng-sre confirms sampling toggle by EOD, we should be green. Otherwise we delay by 24h.

sam: I'll post staging dry-run results here once complete. Thanks all. :pray:
